question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

A long hoped-for revival in private investment has not take place.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (1).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the part **“not take place”.**
 
• The sentence is in the **present perfect tense**. Rule **(Subject + have/has +V3)**
